questions: How many ZrTe5 junctions did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed SQUID-like patterns?
Why were the others set aside, if any were?
Which field ranges, field directions and temperatures did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example By on Dev 1 and Dev 2, or interference patterns above 20 mK?
What does the second-best junction or cooldown look like, for example one with a more Fraunhofer-like pattern?

In your Fig. 5c the two partially merged channels sit at the top and bottom a–c surfaces, which are gapped in a WTI. Can you tune the Fermi level with the Si substrate as a back gate, and follow the edge and bulk weight in Js(x) with density, to separate these from band bending at the substrate and contact interfaces?
Does the diffusive long-junction form fit your Fig. 3d as well as the ballistic exponential, and what are RN, eIcRN and the fitted δE next to the Thouless energy?
What are the estimated loop and kinetic inductances of the NbN and Al leads (the screening parameter), and do the lobes in your Fig. 5b,c round off as temperature lowers Ic?
What are the length, width and flake thickness of Dev 3, how was Ic extracted from the V(I) curves, and how does a uniform-current model at the Dev 3 aspect ratio compare with your Fig. 5c?
